accepted.question_text: Let n be a positive integer written in base 2, and let S(n) be the sum of the binary digits of n. Is the asymptotic density of the set of positive integers n for which S(n^2) is even equal to 1/2? This item is explicitly marked solved in the source: the proof notes state that the problem is a special case of Theorem 3 of Christian Mauduit and Joël Rivat.
